items.title: Closed subsets of a Noetherian space characterised by stability under generalization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes closed, respectively open, subsets of a Noetherian space as the constructible ones stable under specialization, respectively generalization (author lemma at source lines 4014-4024, label lemma-characterize-closed-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 4026-4036) treats the generalization case through the generic point of an irreducible closed subset meeting the set, invokes the openness criterion and applies the result to the complement for the closed case (proof lines 4026-4035). The generic point argument is the substance. H3.
